botcomponent.description: Runs the ICM Operations Agent's two response procedures: a Conversational Mode chat reply (with on-request exports) and an Autonomous/Trigger Mode structured output (Executive Summary plus ICM List JSON). Use when the agent has an incident or operational query to answer and needs to decide, retrieve, and format the response for the current invocation, whether triggered by an interactive chat message or by an automated trigger supplying a natural-language query. Do NOT use this for constructing the OData filter itself or for resolving team/service identifiers -- those stay in the agent's own instructions.
botcomponent.name: icm-dual-mode-response
